web_activity_alert_need_room: An Activity needs a room — that's what makes it exclusive at runtime.
web_activity_alert_pick_harmony: Pick a Harmony hub and device.
web_activity_atv_hint: Woken when the Activity starts, put to sleep when it ends; you can also pick an app to launch on the next screen.
web_activity_confirm_overwrite_volume: Page "%1$s" already has a hotkey for %2$s. Overwrite with "%3$s"'s volume device (%4$s)?
web_activity_devices_hint: Which devices does this Activity involve? You'll pick an input/command for each on the next screens.
web_activity_err_entity_format: That doesn't look like an entity id (domain.object_id, e.g. media_player.salon_ampli).
web_activity_err_pick_entity: Pick an entity in the list or type its id.
web_activity_ha_entity_ph: …or type an entity id, e.g. media_player.salon_ampli
web_activity_info_page_hint: Which page this Activity opens (and its volume keys, if any) is set where you place it on a scene card — not here, since an Activity is only ever triggered from one.
web_activity_keep_on: Keep this device on when switching to another Activity (applies to every Activity that uses it)
web_activity_keep_on_hint: For a device that is the same TV as another one (e.g. the Android TV entity used to launch apps): it is never switched off when another Activity takes the room. "Off" still switches it off if the box above is ticked.
web_activity_no_atv: No Apple TV paired over the network — pair one from this device's home page (Apple TV), then reopen this wizard.
web_activity_no_ha_list: No entity list available here (add HA devices on the Devices page, or open the builder from the remote) — type the entity id instead.
web_activity_no_harmony: No Harmony hub reachable from this builder session — configure one in the app first, or use a local IR device / HA entity instead.
web_activity_no_ir: No IR devices yet — add one from this device's home page, then reopen this wizard.
web_activity_now_playing_auto: Automatic (its network Apple TV, otherwise the dock's own list)
web_activity_now_playing_hint: The media player that is the content source of this Activity (e.g. the Apple TV, not the TV or the amp). While this Activity is the one running in the remote's room, the dock clock shows only that player.
web_activity_now_playing_label: Now playing on the dock clock (optional)
web_activity_power_off_on_exit: Power off when this Activity ends and another one takes the room
web_activity_power_on_first: Power on when this Activity starts (uncheck for an always-on device)
web_activity_review_no_commands_many: %1$d devices have no commands set — they won't do anything when this Activity runs.
web_activity_review_no_commands_one: %1$d device has no commands set — it won't do anything when this Activity runs.
web_activity_review_volume_bound: bound to the physical volume keys wherever you place this Activity on a scene card.
web_activity_type_hint: What is this Activity for? (just picks a starting name — everything else is up to you)
web_activity_volume_bound_hint: Bound to physical volume keys wherever you place this Activity on a scene card, once saved.
web_activity_volume_commands_q: Which commands on %1$s are volume up, volume down, and mute?
web_activity_volume_hint: Which device should VOLUME_UP/DOWN/MUTE target while this Activity is active?
web_card_10_s_buttons_full_and_hold: ±10 s buttons (full) and hold ◀ ▶ to jump 10 s
web_card_active_color_optional_hex_backg: Active color (optional, hex — background while the state above matches)
web_card_alert_data_json: Extra data must be valid JSON
web_card_alert_pick_hub_activity: Pick a hub and an activity.
web_card_alert_pick_hub_device: Pick a hub and a device.
web_card_alert_pick_hub_device_command: Pick a hub, a device, and a command.
web_card_alert_pick_ir_command: Pick an IR command, or clear the IR device field.
web_card_alert_plex_fields: Fill in the Plex server URL, token, and a playback entity.
web_card_alert_room_clean_fields: Fill in all three room-clean service fields (domain, service, and field name), or leave all three blank.
web_card_alert_room_name_id: Room needs a name and a numeric ID
web_card_alert_title_required: Set a title, a subtitle, or both.
web_card_alert_top_buttons_json: Top buttons JSON is invalid — fix it or leave as []. Card not added.
web_card_alert_track_needs_room: A tracked Activity needs a Room — that's what makes it exclusive at runtime.
web_card_app_is_the_name_as_the: "App" is the name as the Apple TV lists it (suggestions come from the entity's source_list). Icon: a PNG uploaded to the device (Choose…) or an image URL; without one, the app's initials are shown on its color. Compact shows up to 6, classic and full up to 5.
web_card_apple_tv_direct_no_home_assista: Apple TV (direct — no Home Assistant needed)
web_card_as_a_popup_over_the_current: ...as a popup, over the current page
web_card_automatic_uses_the_directly_pai: "Automatic" uses the directly paired Apple TV. Through a Harmony hub, pick Home Assistant's Apple TV media_player to get the artwork, title and app launching.
web_card_calendar_entity: Calendar entity (optional — shows today's event under the date)
web_card_camera_hint: "Live stream" decodes Home Assistant's MJPEG feed for real motion; if it stalls it auto-falls-back to still snapshots, then retries. If a camera feels laggy on the remote, switch that card to "Snapshot only" — no reinstall needed. The preview below pulls one real frame from this device when it's connected to HA.
web_card_camera_interval: Snapshot interval (seconds — snapshot mode, and stream-drop fallback)
web_card_camera_mode_snapshot: Snapshot only (refresh a still — lowest CPU)
web_card_climate_fan_modes: Fan modes override (optional, comma-separated, in display order — normally read from the entity)
web_card_climate_hint: HVAC/fan/swing mode names ("Cooling", "Auto", "Swing"...) are translated automatically via assets/ha_labels/<lang>.json. The "off" mode never shows as a chip — it's already covered by the power button.
web_card_climate_hvac_modes: HVAC modes override (optional, comma-separated, in display order — normally read from the entity)
web_card_climate_swing_modes: Swing modes override (optional, comma-separated, in display order — normally read from the entity)
web_card_clock_weather_hint: The condition text ("Partly cloudy", "Rainy"...) is translated automatically via assets/ha_labels/<lang>.json — no field needed here.
web_card_close_the_open_popup_after_this: Close the open popup after this button's action
Close the open popup after this tile's action
web_card_compact_remote_first_now_playin: Compact — remote first, now-playing strip, app icons
web_card_compact_unticking_both_artwork_: Compact: unticking both artwork and progress removes the now-playing strip and brings back the classic Play/Pause button. ±10 s and holds need a directly paired Apple TV.
web_card_confirm_delete: Delete the card "%1$s" from this page?
web_card_controls_mushroom_cover: Controls (Mushroom-style — same options as the Home Assistant Mushroom cover card)
web_card_controls_mushroom_light: Controls (Mushroom-style — same options as the Home Assistant Mushroom light card)
web_card_cover_hint: Status shows "Open"/"Closed" at 0%/100%, otherwise "N% open" — translated automatically in the app. Up/down buttons auto-disable once fully open/closed. If several controls are checked, only one shows at a time on the card — a small button cycles through them, same as Mushroom. Position/tilt sliders only appear if the entity actually reports that attribute.
web_card_cover_layout_vertical: Vertical (icon, name, state, controls — all centered/stacked)
web_card_custom_hint: This card type isn't fully modeled in the builder yet — paste the options object directly.
web_card_err_button_action: Give this button a Service, an IR device + command, a Harmony action, or an Activity to turn off.
web_card_err_long_press_json: Long-press action must be valid JSON
web_card_err_long_press_object: Long-press action must be a JSON object, e.g. {"service":"script.lights_off"}
web_card_err_target_state: Give a Target state for the State entity, or clear the State entity field.
web_card_fan_hint: "Auto" shows the full layout (power button, presets, oscillate toggle) whenever the entity reports preset_modes or an oscillating attribute; otherwise it falls back to the simple percentage tile. "Step" uses HA's increase/decrease speed services. Force one with Layout above.
web_card_fan_preset_modes: Preset modes override (optional, comma-separated, in display order — normally read from the entity)
web_card_for_a_button_placed_inside_a: For a button placed *inside* a popup page (e.g. a TV/Projector source picker) — fires this button's action above, then dismisses the popup it's shown in.
web_card_for_a_tile_placed_inside_a: For a tile placed *inside* a popup page (e.g. a TV/Projector source picker) — fires this tile's action above, then dismisses the popup it's shown in. Works whether or not this same tile also sets "Page to open" above.
web_card_forecast_rows: Forecast rows (days shown below the clock)
web_card_full_artwork_seek_bar_10_s: Full — artwork, seek bar, ±10 s, labelled apps, remote
web_card_full_layout_the_first_2_buttons: Full layout: the first 2 buttons sit beside −10 s / Play / +10 s; the next ones (up to 6) go in two columns either side of the trackpad. Compact and full size the trackpad so the card fits on one page (status bar and page dots included).
web_card_grid_button_list_hint: Click a button below to edit it. Add every button, then click "Add card to page" once below.
web_card_grid_color: Color (optional, ARGB hex — defaults to the standard tile color)
web_card_grid_devices_hint: Lets a later *composed* Activity in the same room know this device was already on, so it doesn't needlessly re-toggle it (matters most for a device with only a Power Toggle command, no discrete on/off). Especially worth setting for a Harmony-backed tile — Astrion has no other way to know which physical devices a Harmony Activity touches.
web_card_grid_devices_label: Physical devices this Activity involves (optional — IR/Harmony device ids, comma-separated)
web_card_grid_icon_fill: Fill tile with icon (hide name recommended; icon scales to fill tile height)
web_card_grid_ir: IR device + command (sends locally, no hub needed) — OR —
web_card_grid_no_activities_hint: No Activities yet — create one in the "Activities" section below for multi-device setups (e.g. IR-only, no Harmony/HA).
web_card_grid_now_playing_hint: The media player the dock clock's "Now playing" follows while this Activity is running (its content source, e.g. the Apple TV). Optional.
web_card_grid_scene_list_hint: Click a scene below to edit it. Add every scene, then click "Add card to page" once below.
web_card_grid_show_labels: Show name under icon (when any scene has one — applies to the whole grid)
web_card_grid_track_hint: Makes this tile show up as the active AV Activity for its room — see ActivityRuntime. At most one tracked Activity is active per room at a time. Not needed if you picked a Composed Activity above — that's always tracked automatically, using its own room.
web_card_harmony_action_optional_or_and_: Harmony action (optional — OR/AND combine with Service above)
web_card_independent_of_track_as_activit: Independent of "Track as Activity" below — works on any tile, not just an Activity one. Useful for a plain navigation tile (e.g. to a "Lights" page) that you want lit up while any light in the room is on, say.
web_card_ir_device_command_sends_locally: IR device + command (sends locally, no hub needed)
web_card_light_collapsible: Hide the controls area entirely while the light is off
web_card_light_hint: Tap toggles the light; long-press opens the brightness/colour detail popup. Status shows "Éteint"/"Off" at 0%, otherwise the live "N%" brightness — translated automatically in the app. If several controls are checked, only one shows at a time on the card — a small button cycles through them, same as Mushroom. Colour temperature/swatches only appear if the entity actually supports them.
web_card_light_use_color: Tint the icon with the light's own colour (when it reports one)
web_card_long_press_action_optional_json: Long-press action (optional, JSON — fired on hold instead of tap)
web_card_long_press_hint: A separate action for a long press (touch hold or held OK key) — the fields above still drive a normal tap. Accepts the same fields as a normal %1$s tile: "service" (+ "entity_id", "data"), "entity_id" alone (turn_on), "harmonyDevice"+"harmonyCommand", "activityId", "hub", "irDevice"+"irCommand", "activity", "page" (+ "pageMode": "popup"), "closePopup". Leave empty for no long-press.
web_card_media_hint: Every button above is still hidden automatically when the entity doesn't actually support it (checked live against its supported_features) — these checkboxes just control what's requested. In the compact tile, transport and volume controls share one row with a small swap button when both are present.
web_card_media_name_label: Name (optional override — otherwise the media title/friendly name is used)
web_card_media_show_volume: Append the volume level ("⸱ N%") to the state line
web_card_media_top_buttons_hint: Each entry fires an arbitrary service call as a full-width button above the album art — e.g. speaker grouping.
web_card_media_top_buttons_label: Top buttons (full variant only — optional, JSON array)
web_card_media_transport_controls: Transport controls (shown in the compact tile's control row / full page's main row)
web_card_media_use_info: Show what's playing (title/artist/app) instead of just the friendly name/state
web_card_media_variant_compact: Compact (Mushroom-style tile, for a grid/list of players)
web_card_media_variant_full: Full (big album art + progress bar, for a dedicated media page)
web_card_monitor_err_rows: Add at least one sensor (an entity id).
web_card_monitor_hint: For sensors with long text (e.g. AVR audio/video info): the vertical layout gives the value the whole width; scrolling keeps it on one line instead of wrapping.
web_card_monitor_layout_vertical: Vertical (name above, value below on its own line)
web_card_monitor_marquee: Scroll long values on one line (marquee)
web_card_monitor_no_rows: No sensor yet — add one below.
web_card_movie_tv_artwork_is_usually_por: Movie/TV artwork is usually portrait — use "Contain" so nothing's cropped, and/or "Portrait" to reshape the tile itself.
web_card_name_optional_friendly: Name (optional, defaults to the entity's friendly name)
web_card_no_catalog_device: No %1$s device in the catalog yet — add one from this device's home page (/) as a "%1$s", then come back here.
web_card_no_ir_devices_yet_add_one: No IR devices yet — add one from this device's home page, then come back here.
web_card_only_affects_tiles_that_show_bo: Only affects tiles that show both an icon and a name — no effect on icon-only tiles ("Show name under icon" off).
web_card_options_json: Options (raw JSON — see the card's Kotlin file for its exact fields)
web_card_pe_advanced_hint: Their options are described on the wiki page "Card Picture elements".
web_card_pe_aspect: Width / height ratio before the image loads (optional)
web_card_pe_click_hint: Click the plan to move the selected element (#) there.
web_card_pe_image_hint: Upload your floor plan on the remote's page (Icons), then pick it here. Opened from the remote, the plan shows below.
web_card_pe_none: No button yet — add one below.
web_card_pe_vacuum: Robot vacuum on the plan (JSON, optional)
web_card_ph_ir_command: command id, e.g. power, hdmi1, volume_up
web_card_ph_room_clean_field: Field for the room ID, e.g. segments
web_card_plex_client_hint: The HA Plex integration expects "video", but requires the Plex client on the TV to already be open and actively connected — HA's own Plex integration has a known, long-standing bug where it otherwise refuses with "Client is not currently accepting playback controls" (this is on Plex/Apple TV's side, not fixable here). HA's native Apple TV integration instead deep-links via "url" and doesn't have that restriction, but needs the Plex app on the Apple TV to support plex:// as a system deep link.
web_card_plex_media_entity: Playback entity (Android TV media_player — used to open Plex when no direct client entity is set)
web_card_plex_play_entity: Direct playback entity (optional — jumps straight to the item instead of just opening the app)
web_card_plex_rows_hint: Movies/TV are detected automatically from your Plex libraries' own type (no need to type a library name) — if several libraries share a type (e.g. "Movies" + "Movies 4K") their items are merged into one row. Tap a poster for a detail view — synopsis, genres, episode browser for a show — with its own Play button, which is what actually attempts a direct deep-link (requires a direct playback entity below, and for the HA Plex integration, that the TV's Plex app is already open and connected). Long-press a poster to open Plex on the playback entity directly (quick action) — bound to long-press rather than tap since these rows scroll under a finger and an accidental tap mid-scroll shouldn't trigger a real Home Assistant call.
web_card_plex_source: Source name (as it appears in that player's source list)
web_card_plex_token_hint: This token is saved in dashboard.json, so it is also in your backups: don't share a backup publicly.
web_card_plex_type_url: HA's native Apple TV integration (url / deep link)
web_card_popup_size_position_come_from_t: Popup size/position come from that page's own dialog (same "Open as popup" fields used by a linked page's swipe-up or an entity-triggered auto-open) — this just triggers it by tapping this tile directly instead.
web_card_row_add: + Add a card to the row
web_card_row_add_child: Add a card to the row
web_card_row_edit_child: Edit a card of the row
web_card_row_err_empty: Add at least one card to the row.
web_card_row_hint: Puts cards side by side, each the same width. 2 cards fit best, 3 at most.
web_card_row_none: No card in the row yet.
web_card_row_too_many: More than 3 cards will be very narrow on the remote's screen.
web_card_saving_this_tile_sets_this_as: Saving this tile sets this as the Activity's page (its own "Page to open" above if set, otherwise whichever page this card is on) — used by the Active Activities overlay's tap-to-navigate, and to bind the physical volume keys if this Activity has a volume device set.
web_card_select_hint: For any input_select.* or select.* entity — shows the current option and, tapped, a dropdown of every option from the entity's own list; picking one calls the right select_option service automatically. For a media_player's own source list (HDMI inputs, apps, etc.) use "Source selector (source_select)" instead — that one reads a different HA attribute/service and won't work here.
web_card_select_icon_color: Icon color (optional, hex — tints the icon, same as the Mushroom select card's own icon_color)
web_card_select_layout_dropdown: Dropdown only (no icon or name, full width)
web_card_service_domain_service_optional: Service (domain.service, optional — OR combine with Harmony/IR below)
web_card_sg_hint: Ticking a speaker on the remote groups it with the main one (media_player.join); unticking removes it. Needs speakers that can be grouped in Home Assistant (Sonos…).
web_card_sg_none: No other speaker yet — add one below.
web_card_state_entity_optional_highlight: State entity (optional — highlights this button based on an HA entity's state)
State entity (optional — highlights this tile based on an HA entity's state)
web_card_stops_whatever_activity_is_runn: Stops whatever Activity is running in that room: Harmony PowerOff for a Harmony Activity, devices off (per their profile) for a composed one. "*" turns off every room. Works alone or with the other actions above.
web_card_switch_on_color: "On" color (optional, ARGB hex — defaults to green)
web_card_title_color_label: Color (optional, ARGB/RGB hex — defaults to the standard title color, also tints the divider line)
web_card_title_divider: Divider line (fills the rest of the row after the title)
web_card_title_hint: A section header for grouping the cards below it — no entity of its own. Setting an icon or the divider always left-aligns the title row regardless of Alignment (that layout has no sensible centered/right-aligned form) — the subtitle below is unaffected. For a tappable title/subtitle (e.g. a "see all" link to another page), use "Other / custom type…" below instead and add title_page / subtitle_page — or any of scene_grid's other action fields with a title_/subtitle_ prefix — directly in the JSON; like every type here, re-saving through this simple form overwrites the card's options from scratch, so those fields wouldn't survive a later edit through it.
web_card_turn_off_a_room_s_activity: Turn off a room's Activity — the Harmony-style "Off" button (optional)
web_card_tv_commands_hint: Only if your TV's remote entity uses other names. Empty = the Android TV command shown.
web_card_tv_media_hint: Used by the app buttons. Empty = the media_player with the same name as the remote entity (what the Android TV Remote integration creates).
web_card_tv_volume_hint: A remote.* entity, e.g. your soundbar's. Empty = the TV.
web_card_vacuum_hint: Add every room, then click "Add card to page" once below. The vacuum's state ("Cleaning", "Docked"...) is translated automatically via assets/ha_labels/<lang>.json.
web_card_vacuum_room_clean_hint: Only needed if your vacuum's HA integration doesn't understand app_segment_clean — e.g. Dreame uses its own dreame_vacuum.vacuum_clean_segment service with a segments field instead. Leave all three blank to keep the default. Fill in all three together, or none.
web_card_visually_highlights_this_button: Visually highlights this button while "State entity" is in "Target state" — e.g. showing which source/input is currently selected (TV / Projector, an input_select mode...), similar to how scene_grid highlights the active Activity.
web_dev_a_4_digit_code_is_now: A 4-digit code is now showing on your TV screen. Enter it below to finish pairing.
web_dev_a_registry_of_named_ir_commands: A registry of named IR commands per physical device — works fully offline, no Harmony hub, no Home Assistant, no cloud. Referenced by scene_grid tiles and by Activities in the dashboard builder.
web_dev_a_second_4_digit_code_is: A second 4-digit code is now showing on your TV. Enter it below to finish.
web_dev_atv_choose: Choose the Apple TV to pair:
web_dev_atv_hint: Control an Apple TV directly over your network — no Home Assistant and no Harmony hub needed. Each paired Apple TV shows up as a media_player entity (for example media_player.appletv_salon) that any media player / source card, button or hotkey can use, and the Apple TV remote card can target it too. Your phone or this remote must be on the same network as the Apple TV.
web_dev_atv_mrp_offer_hint: Paired. You can also pair for Now Playing info (title, artist, artwork, position) — this is a separate, optional pairing; your TV will show a second code. Skip it any time and add it later from the list.
web_dev_atv_none_found: No Apple TV found. Make sure it is awake and on the same network as this remote, then search again.
web_dev_atv_paired: Apple TV paired — its entity is %1$s
web_dev_backup_hint: dashboard.json holds everything built in the dashboard builder — pages, cards, hotkeys, Activities, theme, and this catalog's IR/Home Assistant devices.
web_dev_catalog_update_failed: Could not update the media player catalog: %1$s
web_dev_category_brand_model_files_for_t: Category/brand/model files for the on-device picker shown when adding an IR Device (Category → Brand → Model). Pick your device on the external ir-sniffer tool, then send the resulting file here.
web_dev_configure_each_device_once_cards: Configure each device once — cards reference them by name.
web_dev_confirm_remove_atv:
Remove "%1$s"? Cards using %2$s will stop working until you pair it again.

(You can also remove this remote from the Apple TV under Settings → Remotes and Devices.)
web_dev_confirm_remove_extender:
Remove this extender? IR devices pointed at it will stop working until you point them elsewhere.

(Re-adding it later with the same MAC address restores the same id, so those devices start working again.)
web_dev_confirm_remove_ha: Remove the Home Assistant connection? Cards referencing HA entities will stop working.
web_dev_confirm_remove_ha_device: Remove this device? Cards referencing it will show an empty picker until you point them at another device.
web_dev_confirm_remove_hub: Remove this Harmony hub? Cards/hotkeys that reference it will stop working until you point them at another hub.
web_dev_confirm_remove_ir: Remove this IR device? Scene tiles / Activities referencing it will stop working.
web_dev_confirm_restore: This replaces everything currently on this device (pages, cards, hotkeys, Activities, theme, and this catalog) with the file you picked. Continue?
web_dev_enter_pin: Enter the 4-digit code shown on the TV.
web_dev_err_choose_irdb: Choose a .json category file first (from the ir-database picker).
web_dev_err_extender_host: Enter the extender's IP address or hostname.
web_dev_err_extender_mac:
Enter the extender's MAC address (12 hex digits, e.g. 2C:B4:71:FF:C7:98).

You'll find it on the extender's own web page: open http://%1$s/ and look for "Mac Address".
web_dev_err_hub_ip_first: Enter the hub's IP address first.
web_dev_err_inline_extender: Hand-pasted commands can't target an extender yet — only ir-database references can. Switch to "Reference the ir-database", or set this back to "this remote's own IR blaster".
web_dev_err_mac_exists: An extender with that MAC address already exists ("%1$s"). Edit that one instead of adding a second entry for the same device.
web_dev_err_mac_used: Another extender ("%1$s") already uses that MAC address.
web_dev_err_no_entities: No entities of this type were found — check the Home Assistant connection above.
web_dev_extender_mac_hint: Both are on the extender's own web page — open http://<its-ip>/ in a browser and look for "Mac Address". The MAC is what keeps this extender's identity stable: IR devices point at it by an id derived from the MAC, so you can rename it, move it to a new IP, or even remove and re-add it later without breaking every device that uses it.
web_dev_extenders_hint: Network-connected WiFi IR blasters — point an IR device at one instead of this remote's own built-in IR when it needs to reach a closed cabinet or another room. No Home Assistant required. See astrion-ir-extender for the firmware.
web_dev_harmony_s_own_name_for_each: Harmony's own name for each button, and an optional alias — when set, shown instead everywhere you pick a command elsewhere in this app (scene tiles, hotkeys, Activities).
web_dev_hub_load_failed: Could not load this hub's devices — is it powered on and reachable?
web_dev_hub_no_devices: No devices found on this hub.
web_dev_hubid_detect_failed: Could not auto-detect the hub id — is it powered on and reachable?
web_dev_icon_delete_title: Delete this icon from the remote
web_dev_icon_still_used: ⚠ dashboard.json still uses it %1$s time(s) — those cards will show no icon until you pick another one.
web_dev_icons_load_failed: Could not load the icon list.
web_dev_ir_ref_hint: Must match exactly what you copied into /sdcard/astrion/ir-database/ on the remote — the app resolves the actual commands from that file at runtime, this page never touches ir-database/ itself.
web_dev_ir_target_hint: Same for every card/hotkey that references this device — set it once here, not per-card. Only IR-database-referenced devices (not hand-pasted commands) can target an extender right now. Need one added? Go to IR Extenders.
web_dev_irdb_delete_title: Delete this file from the remote
web_dev_irdb_load_failed: Could not load the IR database file list.
web_dev_irdb_none: No IR database file on this remote yet.
web_dev_irdb_still_used: ⚠ Still used by: %1$s — their IR commands will stop working until the file is sent again.
web_dev_known_command_ids_optional_comma: Known command ids (optional, comma-separated — just for autocomplete above and in scene_grid tiles)
web_dev_mrp_none_found: Nothing found. Make sure the TV is awake and on the same network, then search again.
web_dev_no_commands_found: No commands found for this device.
web_dev_not_connected_to_home_assistant_: Not connected to Home Assistant, or no entities of this type were found.
web_dev_pick_one_entity_from_home_assist: Pick one entity from Home Assistant and give it a name — it'll show up under that name in the matching card type in the dashboard builder, instead of typing/guessing its raw entity id there.
web_dev_plays_this_device_s_own_ringtone: Plays this device's own ringtone/alarm/notification sound on loop for a bit, so a misplaced tablet or remote can be found by ear.
web_dev_rename_prompt: Name of this remote (e.g. "Living room"). Leave empty for the default name.
web_dev_replaces_everything_currently_on: Replaces everything currently on this device — pages, cards, hotkeys, Activities, theme, and this catalog.
web_dev_searching_for_the_now_playing_se: Searching for the Now Playing service…
web_dev_upload_pngs_here_to_use_as: Upload PNGs here to use as custom icons on scene_grid / button_grid cards in the dashboard builder — pick "Choose…" on an icon field there.
web_dev_webhook_id_optional_instant_push: Webhook id (optional — instant push instead of polling)
web_dev_where_should_this_device_s_comma: Where should this device's commands actually get sent from?
web_device_connected_banner: ✓ Connected to this device — dashboard.json was loaded automatically, and "Save to device" applies changes live.
web_device_unreachable: Couldn't reach this device — check the connection, then reload this page.
web_dock_clock_dashboard_then_a_dim_cloc: Clock — dashboard, then a dim clock when idle
web_dock_no_media_player_found_open_the: No media_player found — open the builder from the remote to list them.
web_dock_now_playing_from_none_ticked_an: Now playing from (none ticked = any media player that is playing)
web_dock_room_hint: "Now playing" first follows the Activity running in this room (its own now-playing player). Empty: the only running Activity, if there is just one. Without an Activity player, the list below is used — a playing player before a paused one.
web_dock_what_the_remote_shows_while_it: What the remote shows while it sits on its charging dock. The mode is also switchable on the remote (Settings › Dock screen) — it writes this same value.
web_harmony_load_failed: (failed to load — is the hub connected?)
web_history_confirm_delete: Delete the version of %1$s from the history?
web_history_confirm_restore: Restore the version of %1$s on the remote? The current one stays in the history.
web_history_empty: No version yet: the first one is kept at the next save.
web_history_hint: Every save to the remote is kept here (the last 30, plus the pinned ones). Open a version in the editor to look at it — nothing changes on the remote until you save — or restore it on the remote straight away.
web_history_opened: Version opened in the editor — "Save to device" to apply it, ↶ to go back.
web_history_save_note_ph: Note for this version (optional), e.g. new Apple TV page
web_history_unavailable: The version history isn't available (the remote needs app 1.3.0 or newer).
web_hotkey_activity_hint: Starts it exactly like its scene tile: turns on its devices, selects their inputs, then opens its page.
web_hotkey_err_atv: Pick an Apple TV and a command.
web_hotkey_err_harmony_activity: Pick a hub and an activity.
web_hotkey_err_harmony_command: Pick a hub, a device, and a command.
web_hotkey_err_ir: Pick an IR device and a command.
web_hotkey_err_json: Extra data must be valid JSON
web_hotkey_err_remote: Pick a remote entity and a command.
web_hotkey_err_room_or_all: Enter a room name, or * for every room.
web_hotkey_event_hint: Fires astrion_button on Home Assistant's event bus with event (this name), key, long, page, remote_id and remote_name, so one automation can react differently per remote. Home Assistant only accepts it from an administrator's token. With a push webhook configured it's also sent as {"type": "button", …}.
web_hotkey_no_activities: No Activity yet: create one in "2. Activities" below.
web_hotkey_overlay_activities_top: Active Activities (same as swipe down from the top bar)
web_hotkey_page_popup_hint: The page floats over the current one, sized by its own popup settings (Page settings). Press the key again to close it.
web_hotkey_remote_hint: Pick a remote.* entity. Command suggestions come from the entity's commands_list attribute when present, otherwise from the built-in Android TV keymap.
web_hotkey_room_hint: Jumps straight to the page of whichever Activity is currently active in this room — no picker. Does nothing if that room has nothing active right now. Must match a room name used by a tracked Activity (a composed Activity, or a scene_grid tile / hotkey with "track": true) exactly.
web_hotkey_stop_hint: The Harmony-style "Off" (Harmony's -1): stops whatever Activity is running in that room — Harmony PowerOff for a Harmony Activity, devices off per their profile for a composed one. "*" turns off every room.
web_hotkey_stop_room_ph: room name, or * for every room
web_icon_empty_hint: No icons uploaded yet — add some from the "Icons" section on the device's home page (/) first.
web_icon_error: Can't list icons from here — this only works when the builder is opened from the device itself (http://<remote-ip>:8080/builder/), not the standalone copy. Type the path by hand instead, or upload icons first from the device's home page (/).
web_ir_err_command_id: Give this command an id, e.g. "power", "hdmi1", "volume_up".
web_ir_err_pronto_sections: Pronto code has neither a "once" nor a "repeat" section
web_ir_err_pronto_type: Only "learned" Pronto codes (type 0000) are supported, got type %1$s
web_ir_err_ref_fields: Fill in category, brand, and model — matching exactly what you copied into /sdcard/astrion/ir-database/.
web_ir_no_commands: No commands yet — add one above, or import all of them from a picked model.
web_modal_icon_hint_1: Icons already uploaded via the "Icons" section on the device's home page (
web_modal_parent_hint: Makes this a child page — navigate to it via a card's own "Page to open" (e.g. a scene_grid tile), and a physical button jumps back to the parent automatically.
web_modal_parent_key_hint: Defaults to BACK. Pick a different button if BACK is already used for something else on this page, or if you'd rather reserve BACK entirely. If this page also binds its own hotkey on the chosen button, that hotkey wins and the parent-jump is skipped.
web_page_delete_child_warning: %1$d child page(s) (%2$s) will become top-level pages instead of being deleted.
web_page_delete_confirm: Delete page "%1$s" and everything on it (cards, page hotkeys)?
web_page_hidden_no_activities: (no trackable Activities yet — add one in the Activities tab, or a "track": true scene_grid tile)
web_page_imported: dashboard.json loaded — you can now edit it below.
web_page_need_one: You need at least one page.
web_power_after_that_the_motion_sensor_s: After that the motion sensor sleeps until a button turns the screen on. Never wakes on the dock.
web_power_also_settable_on_the_remote_se: Also settable on the remote (Settings › Display › Screen timeout). The remote needs "Modify system settings" — the same permission as its brightness slider; it asks for it there the first time.
web_power_charging_must_hold_this_long_b: Charging must hold this long before the dock screen shows — a remote set down crooked doesn't flicker it on and off.
web_power_go_quiet_with_home_assistant_a: Go quiet with Home Assistant after the screen is off for (seconds)
web_power_how_this_remote_saves_battery_: How this remote saves battery while its screen is off. The defaults suit most setups.
web_power_motion_off: Off — only the buttons wake the screen
web_power_none_nothing_is_received_while: None — nothing is received while quiet.
web_power_only_for_something_the_remote_: Only for something the remote must react to with its screen off. "Find my remote" doesn't need it.
web_power_quiet_the_remote_stops_receivi: Quiet = the remote stops receiving every state change (the main battery drain on a busy Home Assistant) and catches up the moment the screen comes on. -1 = never go quiet. Not applied while docked.
web_power_wake_the_screen_when_picked_up: Wake the screen when picked up — for how long after it goes off
web_preview_camera_placeholder: placeholder here — a real still shows when opened from your device's /builder/
web_preview_media_long_press: long-press the compact tile in-app opens the detail dialog
web_preview_no_cards: No cards on this page yet.
web_preview_no_overrides: no overrides set — showing example modes (your real device's modes render live in the app)
web_preview_no_rooms: No rooms configured — start/pause/dock/locate controls only.
web_preview_plex_no_rows: No rows enabled — edit the card to turn at least one on.
web_preview_plex_placeholder: Titles/posters shown here are placeholders — real Plex data loads live on the device.
web_profile_input_note: Pick a named input below to run its full key sequence — it is only sent when the input actually changes.
web_profile_summary: Harmony profile — power: %1$s; waits %2$s ms after power-on; each key sent %3$s×. Leave the power commands empty to use the profile's own.
web_profile_toggle_note: Astrion remembers whether it is on, so the toggle is only sent when needed — if it ever gets out of sync, use "Help" in Active Activities.
web_theme_hint: Colors used across every card and the dashboard shell. Defaults match the built-in look — change any to customize. The preview updates live.
web_ui_action_ir_command: IR command (remote's own blaster or IR extender)
web_ui_action_return_activity: Return to current Activity (for one room)
web_ui_activities_hint: A composed AV Activity ("Watch Apple TV", "Listen to Music"...) that orchestrates more than one device, mixing IR/Harmony/HA freely. Scoped to one room — at runtime, only one Activity is active per room at a time. For a single-device/single-action Activity (one HA script, one existing Harmony Activity), you don't need this section — just tick "Track as Activity" on a scene_grid tile instead.
web_ui_apple_tv_command_direct_no_home: Apple TV command (direct — no Home Assistant needed)
web_ui_auto_open_when_this_entity_s: Auto-open when this entity's state is (optional)
web_ui_automatically_jumps_to_this_page_: Automatically jumps to this page the moment the entity's state matches the "open" one above (e.g. a doorbell switch turning on) — remembering wherever you were, so BACK/the chevron return there. Leave "close when" blank for the simple on/off case: closes on any state other than the open one. Set it explicitly for anything with more than two meaningful states — a cover's open/opening/closing/closed, a lock's locked/unlocked — so a transitional state doesn't force the page shut mid-way (e.g. open="open", close="closed" ignores "opening"/"closing" entirely). You can always close it yourself too, the same way as tapping "‹ back". For BACK on the remote itself to also close it, also set a "Parent page" above — the hardware BACK button only knows about that static field, not this dynamic close.
web_ui_check_this_if_some_tile_s: Ticked by itself when a tile, a button or a key of this dashboard opens THIS page as a popup ("pageMode": "popup"). Tick it yourself if something else does, so the size below is saved. Not needed when "Linked page"/"Auto-open" above are already set to popup: a page's popup shape is one setting, however it gets opened.
web_ui_devices_hint: Home Assistant, Harmony Hub(s), and IR Devices are configured once from this device's home page (open it) — everything below just references them by name.
web_ui_full_page_jump_there_same_as: Full page (jump there, same as today)
web_ui_full_page_swipe_there_same_as: Full page (swipe there, same as today)
web_ui_hide_completely_swiping_skips_thi: Hide completely — swiping skips this page while the Activity is off, and the remote leaves it when the Activity stops (tiles, hotkeys and Home Assistant can still open it)
web_ui_hide_unless_this_activity_is_runn: Hide unless this Activity is running (optional)
web_ui_home_assistant_event_tells_ha_whi: Home Assistant event (tells HA which remote & button)
web_ui_import_placeholder: Paste your current dashboard.json here to edit it, or leave empty to start fresh.
web_ui_ir_ondevice_label: Already on this remote — pick one
web_ui_ir_source_inline: Paste Pronto codes by hand — for a one-off button, or something you learned yourself
web_ui_ir_source_question: Where do this device's commands come from?
web_ui_ir_source_reference: Reference the ir-database — for a device you picked with the ir-database picker and copied onto the remote
web_ui_leaves_this_page_s_dot_out: Leaves this page's dot out of the indicator until the chosen Activity is actually running, then shows it automatically — handy for decluttering a page tied to a device that isn't always in use. Lists both composed Activities (the "Activities" tab) and "track": true scene_grid tiles/hotkeys, Harmony ones included — same set ActivityRuntime tracks at runtime. Doesn't affect swiping to the page directly (a scene_grid tile's own "page" field, a hardware button, etc. — see the field's own note in AppConfig.kt for why), just its dot.
web_ui_linked_page_hint: Swiping UP from this page's dots jumps straight to the linked page — handy for a "more options" page under a card (e.g. extra Apple TV controls). Several different pages can all link to the same shared page (e.g. a "TV Remote" page with HDMI/amp controls, linked from both "Apple TV" and "Xbox"): leave that shared page's own "Parent page" empty and it'll automatically return to whichever page you actually swiped up from, rather than always jumping back to one fixed page. Only set a "Parent page" on the linked page if it should always return to one specific place regardless of how you got there.
web_ui_opened_as_a_popup_from_a: Opened as a popup by a tile or a key
web_ui_popup_floats_over_whatever_page_y: Popup (floats over whatever page you're on)
web_ui_scope_page: This page only (overrides global while page is active)
web_ui_shared_by_linked_page_auto_open: Shared by "Linked page", "Auto-open", and "Opened as a popup by a tile or a key" above, whichever is set to popup/checked: a page's popup shape is one setting, however it gets opened.
web_ui_subtitle: Build your dashboard visually, no hand-written JSON required. Matches the exact schema the app reads.
web_ui_tap_hint: 🔍 Tap the screen to edit at full size
web_ui_the_popup_shows_the_linked_page: The popup shows the linked page's own cards floating over whatever page you're on — the page itself doesn't change. Closed by tapping outside it or its ✕. Width/height/position are set below.
web_ui_turn_off_a_room_s_activity: Turn off a room's Activity ("Off", like Harmony's -1)
web_ui_uses_the_same_width_height_positi: Uses the same width/height/position settings as "Linked page" above (a page's popup shape is one setting, however it gets opened). Ideal for something like an intercom/doorbell call: it shows over whatever you're doing without losing your place, and closes itself the same way full-page mode would — the entity leaving the "open" state above.
web_weather_card_hint: No Home Assistant? Set your town on the remote's web page (Weather tile) to use the built-in weather.
web_weather_intro: Weather without Home Assistant: the remote fetches the forecast itself from Open-Meteo (free, no account). Pick your town here; it is saved right away.
web_weather_model_auto: Automatic: best model for this place (7 days)
web_weather_search_failed: Search failed (%1$s). Is the remote online?
web_weather_use_it: Then, in the dashboard builder, choose "Built-in weather" as the weather of a clock & weather card or of the dock screen. Updated every 30 minutes while the screen is on.
